title: Pookies 2x/week Upper Lower split
author: CormacExists
desc: An introduction to the gym to grow muscle, get stronger and used to the basic exercises, form, how programming works and how to workout

ex.note: Don't worry about weight, focus on form, slight pause at the bottom. You can use machines if needed as an alternate version etc hack or pendulum squat. Barbell will be harder but more newbie benefits

Another big barbell excersize for the hamstrings ass and erectors. Pick the weight up in a controlled deadlift and lower it down through your legs. Start light and have a slight arch.ShouldFeelStretch
Put a foot elevated onto a bench and another in front of you. A dumbell in each hand. Lower yourself down and up. Balance, ass and quads.
The machine will make it easier for you to get the form. Both legs in, and pull down to a seated position. Make sure the lowering portion is controlled

ss.note:
Theres a sort of movement from dumbells on youre knees to above youre chest.
Focus on form with lighter weight.
Control the weight from above you to down with flared elbows, dumbell slightly diagonal
Have the dumbells, light and controlled, at your sides and move them horizantally up, hands down at your sides to the hugging motion while hands are still down.

ex.note: So find a lat pulldown machine and pick an attatchement, should be bar with a slight bend at the end. Bring it down to about chest height with slight arch under control and control it back up

ss.note: Using the straight bar attatchment, set it up so the bar is a bit above chest, push it down with elbows fairly in place and control it the weigh back up
Set the cable lower, curl with low weight and control, make sure youre safe
